_comment: SHARED cross-language reduction conformance fixture. The Swift ReductionConformanceTests and the Rust tests/reduction_conformance.rs BOTH read this file and assert that NeuronKit's reduction composition produces the RANK-IDENTICAL ordered id list for each case. The reduction fold is integer/fixed-point deterministic; for compositions whose only signals are content/structural (text, text+temporal) the result is bit-identical across languages, and for compositions that read a float lane (dense-fused) the result is rank-identical (the float column participates but the ORDER is stable). Each case supplies the full candidate inputs so both languages build identical ReductionCandidates without a live estate; the expected_order is the precise ranked id list the reduce() returns for that composition at the given limit.

candidates.content: the Versailles indemnity was 46 million marks, current as of 1921
the Versailles indemnity was 11 million marks, superseded; recorded 1919
the Vienna congress redrew the map of Europe in 1815

cases.name: text
cases.query: what was the Versailles indemnity of 46 million marks

cases.query: what was the Versailles indemnity of 46 million marks
